questions.q: What is the main goal of software testing?
options: Prove that the software has no bugs at all
Find problems early and show how ready the product is
Rewrite the code the developers wrote
Slow the release down until it is perfect

questions.q: Which is a positive test for an OTP login page?
options: Log in with a wrong OTP
Leave the mobile number empty
Type letters in the mobile number field
Log in with a registered mobile number and the right OTP

questions.q: Which kind of test checks the whole flow: search, cart, UPI payment, then order confirmation?
options: End-to-end testing
Unit testing
Static code review
Spell checking

questions.q: Selenium is mainly used to…
options: Design database tables
Write requirement documents
Automate actions in a web browser
Track employee leave

questions.q: A form has 3 yes/no options that each change the price. How many combinations cover every case?
A PIN code field must take exactly 6 digits. Which set of test inputs covers it best?
options: 560001 only
Ten random valid 6-digit codes

questions.q: Rules: 5% off above ₹1,000, 10% off above ₹5,000, members get 2% extra. Which technique fits best to design the tests?
options: Only a quick smoke test
Random clicking (monkey testing)
A load test with many users
A decision table of conditions and outcomes

questions.q: An order goes Placed → Packed → Shipped → Delivered and can be cancelled only before Shipped. Which test matters most?
options: Check the font of the status label
Try to cancel a Shipped order and check it is refused
Place 1,000 orders at the same time
Check that the status names are sorted A to Z

questions.q: What is the difference between severity and priority?
options: Severity is the impact; priority is how soon it must be fixed
They mean exactly the same thing
Only clients set severity; only testers set priority
Priority is about the test; severity about the tester

questions.q: A developer says your bug is 'working as designed', but it goes against the written requirement. What do you do?
options: Close the bug at once without comment
Keep arguing until the developer agrees
Show the requirement and ask the product owner or BA to decide
Raise five similar bugs to make the point

questions.q: A day before release you find GST is calculated on the wrong amount for one state. What do you do?
options: Wait until after the release, then report it
Report it now with proof and flag it as a release blocker
Quietly change the GST code yourself
Mention it only in the weekly status mail

questions.q: Which makes a good bug title?
options: Written in capitals so it stands out
The name of the developer who wrote it
A single word such as 'Broken'
Short and specific about what fails, and where

questions.q: Unit testing checks…
options: The whole system with real users
A single function or class on its own
Only the screens and buttons
The live production server

questions.q: Integration testing mainly looks for…
options: Spelling mistakes on each of the screens
Only slow page loads on mobile
Wrong colours and fonts in the layout
Problems where modules or services connect and pass data

questions.q: You are planning tests for a delivery-partner app used mostly on budget Android phones. What must the plan include?
options: Low-RAM devices, slow or dropping networks and low battery
Only the newest flagship phones on the market
Only desktop browser tests on laptops
Only tests on fast office Wi-Fi

questions.q: A performance test is fine at 500 users but times out at 2,000. What must your report include?
options: Just one line saying 'Performance is bad'
Only the average response time at 500 users
The load where it breaks, the errors seen and server metrics then
A screenshot of the login page

questions.q: Which test is the worst choice to automate?
options: The login flow, run on every build
Regression tests of the checkout
A one-time check of a screen being redesigned next week
API tests for the pricing service

questions.q: A Selenium test fails at random because a button is not ready yet. What is the best fix?
options: Use an explicit wait for the button's condition
Add Thread.sleep(10000) before every step
Delete the test from the suite
Re-run it until it passes once

questions.q: In Postman you send POST /orders with a required field missing. What should a well-built API return?
options: 200 OK with an empty order saved
A 500 server error
No response at all, just a timeout
A 4xx error such as 400 with a clear message

questions.q: Why run automated tests in the CI pipeline?
options: So the tests never need updating again
Every change gets checked at once, so breaks are caught early
So manual testing can stop completely
So that builds take longer to finish

questions.q: Testing time is cut from 10 days to 4. How do you decide what to test?
options: Risk-based: test the most used, highest-impact features first
Test the screens in alphabetical order
Skip regression and test only new screens
Run every test case, just faster

task.title: Write test cases and a bug report for a gas booking form
task.brief: Below are the rules for a gas cylinder booking form and one problem seen during testing. In 20 to 25 minutes: (1) write 12 to 15 test cases as a simple table (ID, what you test, test data, expected result), covering positive, negative and boundary cases, and (2) write a clear bug report for the observed problem (title, steps, expected, actual, environment, severity and priority with a short reason). Say which 3 test cases you would run first if time were short, and why.
task.material:
Screen: 'Book a gas cylinder refill' (mobile web)

Fields and rules
1. Consumer number: required, exactly 10 digits.
2. Mobile number: required, 10 digits, must start with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
3. Delivery PIN code: required, exactly 6 digits, must be in the serviceable list.
4. Delivery slot: Morning / Afternoon / Evening. Same-day slots close at 12:00 noon.
5. Payment: UPI ID (format name@bank) or Cash on delivery.
6. Amount: filled in by the system from the cylinder price (₹1 to ₹5,000). Not editable.
7. 'Book now' button: enabled only when all required fields are valid.
   One booking per consumer number every 15 days.

Observed during testing (build 2.4.1, Chrome on Android 13, Redmi phone):
- Consumer 1234567890 booked on 1 Nov. On 10 Nov the same consumer could book again.
key_points: Boundary tests for lengths: 9, 10, 11 digit consumer and mobile numbers; 5, 6, 7 digit PIN codes
Mobile starting with 0-5 is refused; starting with 6-9 accepted
Non-serviceable PIN, letters/special characters and blank fields are refused with clear messages
Slot cut-off at 12:00 noon tested just before and just after; UPI format valid and invalid; COD path
Book now stays disabled until all fields are valid; amount not editable
15-day rule tested at day 14, 15 and 16 (boundary) and double-click / repeat booking
Bug report has a specific title, numbered steps, expected vs actual, build and device, and sensible severity/priority (high: business rule broken)
Picks risk-based first tests (booking rule, payment, required-field validation) with reasons

rubric.label: Coverage
rubric.guide: 0 = only a few happy-path cases, 3 = positive and some negative cases, 5 = positive, negative and boundary cases across all fields and rules

rubric.label: Test design
rubric.guide: 0 = vague cases with no data or expected result, 3 = mostly clear, 5 = each case has precise data and an exact expected result, using boundaries and partitions

rubric.label: Bug report
rubric.guide: 0 = missing or 'it doesn't work', 3 = has steps but lacks expected/actual or environment, 5 = complete, reproducible, with justified severity and priority

rubric.label: Prioritisation
rubric.guide: 0 = no choice made, 3 = choice made with weak reasons, 5 = picks the riskiest cases and explains why clearly
